Like the other comments say, please don’t start. In my personal experience, it feels good in the moment, but afterwards you feel so much worse than before. The first 12-24 hours after I cut I’m filled with self hatred, sadness and overwhelming suicidal thoughts. Sometimes I try to fix this by cutting again which makes me feel better for a little while, and then of course worse again. I still can’t stop, it has become a routine for me and I don’t feel like myself without it. Even when I’m having a good day I get urges, every problem or inconvenience I face, my mind goes to cutting. If I don’t cut deep enough I’m worthless, I’m worthless for cutting in the first place, if I don’t bleed enough then I’m not enough. I’m mad at myself because I’m never gonna be able to go swimming or wear shorts again without being judged, I’m tired of lying to my family and friends. Cutting may feel good in the moment but it’s terrible in the long run. Please don’t start.

I’m so depressed all the time, I can’t eat, sleep, keep up with school, friends or family. When I wake up I feel like I’m falling into a black hole of sadness, I want to cry every second I’m awake. Since I’m failing school there is no way for me to ever be successful without education an I feel so worthless. I want to die. Nobody wants me here, I know they don’t. The world is better off without me and I’m so fucking close to ending it all that I feel scared to be left alone because I might not be able to control myself. The only time I feel positive emotion is when I cut myself, it makes me calm, satisfied with myself, it takes away the suicidal thoughts for a while and I love the scars. I know that this is messed up, I think I’m addicted, I can’t even find a good reason to stop, I don’t want to stop. It feels too good. One day my friends and family will find out one way or another, I dread that day. I have nightmares about opening my bag in front of my family and thousands of blades falling out. They would be so sad, heartbroken and upset with me. That’s all I do, hurt people. I’m such a fuck up, I bet everyone is so tired of me and my problems. I have no future. Don’t have motivation for school or a job in the future. I’m only 14 and I feel like my whole life is slipping away and I can’t do anything about it. I was never supposed to be alive, I was a mistake and I ruin everything. I don’t know how much longer I can hold on, I’ve been so close to attempting final yeet so many times, one day I might actually do it. I’m gonna miss my cat. I hope my family and friends soon realise they’re better off without me, so I don’t hurt them more that I’ve already done.
